zh_simp: 我很抱歉,您找的那本书已经没有库存了,都卖光了。

en: I've been handing out business cards all day, and now I'm all out of them.
zh_simp: 我一整天都在分发我的名片,现在已经发完了。

en: Valentina found a beautiful dress at the department store, but she wanted to try it on before she bought it.
zh_simp: 马伦蒂娜在百货公司看到了一件漂亮的连衣裙,但她想先试试再买。

en: Please don't stop telling your story. Please go on.
zh_simp: 请继续讲你的故事,不要停。

en: The concert had to be called off because of the typhoon.
zh_simp: 演唱会因为台风取消了。

en: Tomorrow, I'm off to Paris.
zh_simp: 我明天出发去巴黎。

en: Oscar left home at the age of 18 and went off to Spain.
zh_simp: 奥斯卡18岁离开家,去了西班牙。

en: Our plane was delayed on the tarmac and we couldn't take off for an hour.
zh_simp: 我们的飞机在停机坪上被延误,整整一个小时都无法起飞。

en: My parents and friends saw me off at the airport before I embarked on my adventure around the world.
zh_simp: 我的父母和朋友在机场为我送别,然后我踏上了环游世界的冒险之旅。

en: I don't want to keep going on discussing marketing. Let's move on to the production issues.
zh_simp: 我不想继续讨论市场营销的问题了,让我们来看看生产上的问题。

en: Mahmoud always dozes off in economics class.
zh_simp: 马哈茂德总是在经济课上打瞌睡。

en: The food was lousy and the service sucked. Then they charged us an arm and a leg. We totally got ripped off.
zh_simp: 食物糟糕,服务差劲,他们还收了我们一大笔钱,我们完全是被宰了。

en: He always buys expensive things to show off.
zh_simp: 他总是买昂贵的东西来炫耀。

en: Some old houses were torn down to make room for a new housing development. The owners of the houses tried to protest, but it was to no avail.
zh_simp: 一些旧房子被拆除了,以便腾出空间盖新房子,这些屋主试着去抗争,但无济于事。

en: One man was so upset by the whole ordeal that he committed suicide.
zh_simp: 有一个男人因为受不了所有的磨难自杀了。

en: The firefighters were able to put the fire out before the house burned down.
zh_simp: 在房子没被烧垮前,消防队员把火扑灭了。

en: However, the firefighters had a hard time trying to calm a woman down. Apparently, her cat perished in the fire.
zh_simp: 然而,消防队员在试图安慰一位女士冷静下来时,遇到了困难,显而易见,她的猫在火灾中丧生了。

en: Talks between Russia and the United States have broken down.
zh_simp: 俄罗斯和美国之间的谈判已经破裂。

en: After college, Zahida was turned down from every job she applied for. Finding a job was difficult.
zh_simp: 大学刚毕业的扎西达申请的所有工作都没被录用,找工作很困难。

en: When Ichiro had just arrived in London, a man came up to him in the street and asked for money, so he gave him a few Japanese yen.
zh_simp: 一郎刚到伦敦时,一名男子走上前跟他要钱,所以他给了他几块日元。

en: The police are going to ask us a lot of questions, so we need to back each other up.
zh_simp: 警察要问我们很多问题,所以我们要互相支持。

en: The police set up a special task force to investigate the murders.
zh_simp: 警方成立了专案小组来调查这起谋杀。

en: You should always back up your computer files just in case the hard drive dies.
zh_simp: 你应该随时备份你的电脑档案,以防硬盘坏了。

en: You should always save your files as you're working on them just in case your computer crashes.
zh_simp: 你编辑文件时应该随时存档,以防电脑突然死机。

en: The police accidentally shot and killed a man. They tried to cover up what really happened, but it became a big scandal.
zh_simp: 警方意外开枪打死了一名男子,他们试图掩盖事实真相,但结果成了一件大丑闻。

en: They couldn't just brush it under the carpet and expect everything to blow over and go away.
zh_simp: 他们只是掩盖问题,然后期望什么都没发生过。

en: The murder suspect got bad press, but he wasn't the culprit. He was not the man who did it.
zh_simp: 杀人嫌疑犯有很多负面新闻,但他不是元凶,人不是他杀的。

en: Since he got so much bad press, it wouldn't just blow over. Everybody knew him now.
zh_simp: 因为它有太多负面新闻,大家不会那么容易就忘了,现在每个人都知道它是谁了。

en: So he sued and was awarded compensation for damage to his reputation.
zh_simp: 因此,他提出上诉并要求赔偿他的名誉损失。

en: We just won a new contract, but completing it will take up the next three months.
zh_simp: 我们刚刚签了一份新合约,但完成它需要三个月。

en: My parents were away on business when I was a child, so my grandparents brought me up. My grandparents raised me.
zh_simp: 我小的时候,因为我父母常年在外地出差,所以是爷爷奶奶把我抚养长大,我爷爷奶奶把我养大。

en: If you can't find a hotel for the night, you'll end up sleeping on the street.
zh_simp: 如果你找不到旅馆过夜,你最后只能睡大街。

en: There was a fight on the street and three men ended up in the hospital.
zh_simp: 街上有人打架,最后三名男子被送进了医院。

en: Don't argue with a police officer or you'll just end up getting arrested.
zh_simp: 不要和警察争辩,否则最后你会被逮捕。

en: There are two universities in the city and students make up 20% of the population.
zh_simp: 这个城市有两所大学,学生人数占了总人口的20%。

en: I'll be ready in a few minutes. You go on ahead and I'll catch up with you.
zh_simp: 我几分钟内就准备好了,你先去,我可以追上你。

en: My parents dropped me off at the airport two hours before my flight was scheduled to take off.
zh_simp: 我父母在飞机起飞前两个小时把我送到了机场。

en: My parents were there again to pick me up when I flew back home.
zh_simp: 我坐飞机回家时,我爸妈也去机场接了我。

en: Simon is terribly creative and is always coming up with great ideas.
zh_simp: 希盟总是有着无穷的创意,而且能想出许多伟大的想法。

en: I'm saving my money up for a trip around the world.
zh_simp: 我存钱是为了环游世界。

en: The F1 racer caught fire and blew up. Luckily, the driver just narrowly escaped.
zh_simp: F1赛车起火爆炸了,幸运的是驾驶员死里逃生。

en: A friend of mine was attacked and beaten up a few days ago. He's been in the hospital ever since.
zh_simp: 我的朋友几天前被袭击和殴打了,从那之后他一直住院。

en: Ludwig and Rita broke up. Ludwig and Rita split up.
zh_simp: 路德维西和丽塔分手了。

en: Ludwig and Rita ended up breaking up. Ludwig and Rita ended up splitting up.
zh_simp: 路德维希和利塔最终还是分手了。

en: They couldn't get along with each other, so the relationship didn't work out in the end.
zh_simp: 他们无法与对方很好的相处,所以最后以失败告终。

en: Plans to build a new factory have been held up because of the company's financial problems.
zh_simp: 因为公司的财务问题,建新工厂的计划被搁置了。

en: We live next to an international airport, so we have to put up with a lot of noise.
zh_simp: 我们住在国际机场旁,所以我们每天要忍受很多噪音。

en: The two brothers are identical twins, so everybody gets them mixed up.
zh_simp: 两兄弟是同卵双胞胎,所以每个人都会把他们弄混。

en: Your house is an absolute mess. When are you going to get this place cleaned up?
zh_simp: 你的房子一团乱,你什么时候才会把这里打扫干净?

en: When your language training starts getting tough, it means you're about to make a big breakthrough, so stick with it and don't give up.
zh_simp: 当你觉得语言训练开始越来越难了,那就代表你很快就会有突破了,所以要坚持,不要放弃。

en: Whoever used up all the milk and eggs should go out and buy some more and get some toilet paper while you're at it.
zh_simp: 把牛奶喝完,把鸡蛋吃光的人要再买一些回来,顺便买点卫生纸。

en: People used to carry pagers around, but they've completely fallen out of use.
zh_simp: 以前人们随身携带寻呼机,但现在已经完全过时了。

en: My manager pointed out a potential problem with our new marketing plan.
zh_simp: 我的经理在我们的新市场营销企划案中指出了一个潜在的问题。

en: A decision has to be made now. We can't put it off any longer.
zh_simp: 我们现在就得做出决定,不能再拖下去了。

en: I was offered a job at the oil company, but I decided to turn it down.
zh_simp: 我得到了一份石油公司的工作,但我决定婉拒。

en: Several men got angry with Jack in the bar and Jack told them he wasn't afraid to take them on.
zh_simp: 酒吧里,杰克得罪了几个男人,杰克说他不怕他们放马过来。

en: They took it out into the street and Jack let them have it. Jack put them down one by one and the spectacle really drew a crowd.
zh_simp: 他们到马路上,然后杰克给了他们一个下马威,杰克一个接一个打倒了他们,这样的情景吸引了很多人围观。

en: A man was knocked down by a car when crossing the street and had to be taken to the hospital.
zh_simp: 一名男子过马路时被车撞倒,不得不被送进医院。

en: In the aftermath of the tornado, they discovered a lot of uprooted trees and houses that had been blown down.
zh_simp: 龙卷风过后,他们发现了很多被连根拔起的树木和被吹倒的房屋。

en: Please calm down. Everything will turn out all right.
zh_simp: 请冷静下来,一切都会好转的。

en: When the police questioned him, he decided to leave out an important detail.
zh_simp: 警方询问他时,他决定保留重要的细节不说。

en: When talking with the police, you shouldn't make up stories or lie.
zh_simp: 和警察交谈时,你不应该编造故事或说谎。

en: When Sarah decided to move to India and start a new life, she gave away all of her belongings.
zh_simp: 当莎拉决定搬到印度,开始新的生活时,她把全部家当都送人了。

en: Put a smile on your face and you'll certainly get lots of smiles back.
zh_simp: 把微笑挂在脸上,你一定会得到更多的笑容回应。

en: I waved to the children on the bus and they waved back.
zh_simp: 我向大巴上的孩子们挥手,他们也朝着我挥手。

en: My first job was at a travel agency and I didn't like it much, but now looking back on the experience, I really learned a lot.
zh_simp: 我的第一份工作在一家旅行社,我不太喜欢,但现在回头看,那时我真的学到了很多东西。

en: When are you going to pay me back the money I lent you?
zh_simp: 你打算什么时候还我借你的钱?

en: When you cause problems with the wrong people, those problems will come pay you back or come back to haunt you.
zh_simp: 如果你给错的人制造了麻烦,这些麻烦会再还给你,或者一直困扰着你。

en: The lone ranger got on his horse and rode off into the sunset.
zh_simp: 独行侠上了马,骑向日落。
